During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] including the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sarapin Wanderer]]'' was '''attacked''' by Imperial ships. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the ''Wanderer''{{'s}} captain, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] took command and organized a counterattack that drove the enemy into a nearby [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] to destroy them.
